note: One narrator, eleven_v3 (v4 is refused on the free queue). One file per line in voice/el/mp3/<take>.mp3.
voice_name: Calen Voss - Resonant, Magnetic (deep American baritone)
lines: [calm, intrigued] Day one. Your phone shows you tomorrow.
[mysterious] Nine fourteen A.M. A man drops his coffee.
[slowly, amazed whisper] At nine fourteen... he does.
[excited] Day four. Las Vegas. It knows the winning number.
[triumphant] You walk out with two million dollars.
[serious, ominous] Day twelve. Miami. It shows a storm, and a bridge that falls at noon.
[urgent] You block the road. Everyone yells at you.
[relieved, emotional] At noon, the bridge goes down. Nobody is on it.
[uneasy] Day twenty-one. A message, from your own number.
[matter-of-fact] And this isn't all fiction. Google DeepMind's AI already forecasts the weather ten days ahead.
[warm, curious] Would you look at tomorrow? Follow for more what-ifs.
